newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - Pasminco to take BHP lead concentrate.
newsitem.headline: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - Pasminco to take BHP lead concentrate.

text.p: Base metals producer Pasminco Ltd said on Thursday it would take 70,000 tonnes of lead concentrate a year from The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd's Cannington mine in north Queensland after 1998.
"The contract is for 70,000 tonnes per annum, though in the first year of the contract, 1998, the tonnage will be a figure less than that," a spokeswoman for Pasminco told Reuters.

Pasminco executive general manager, metals, John Winckel earlier said Cannington would be the major source "in due course" of feed to the company's lead smelter at Port Pirie, with about 12 years life remaining for its Broken Hill resource.
However he said it could not be considered a direct substitution for Broken Hill, and other feed sources were being developed.
